Purpose of KidsMap</h2>\n              \n            </div>\n\n            <div class="legal-section-body">\n              \n                \n                  <p>KidsMap is an informational catalog and navigation platform for children&#x27;s clubs, sports sections, creative studios, educational centers, specialists, and family events.</p>\n                \n              \n                \n                  <ul class="legal-bullets-list">\n                    \n                      <li>search for children&#x27;s activities and events by districts, metro stations, and interests;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>apply filters by age, category, and preferences;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>save favorite places to personal bookmarks;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>publish reviews, ratings, and feedback reactions;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>connect directly with venue management through contact buttons;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>list new venues and submit place management requests;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>update and maintain club information when authorized;</li>\n                    \n                  </ul>\n                \n              \n                \n                  <p>Unless explicitly stated otherwise, KidsMap is an independent information directory, is not the organizer of listed clubs, and does not provide educational or athletic services on their behalf.</p>\n                \n              \n\n              \n            </div>\n          </article>\n        \n          <article\n            id="user-categories"\n            class="legal-doc-section "\n          >\n            <div class="legal-section-header">\n              <h2 class="legal-section-title">3. Purpose of KidsMap</h2>\n              \n            </div>\n\n            <div class="legal-section-body">\n              \n                \n                  <p>KidsMap is an information platform and a catalog of kids&#x27;:</p>\n                \n              \n                \n                  <ul class="legal-bullets-list">\n                    \n                      <li>clubs;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>sports sections;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>educational courses;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>creative <li>events.</li>\n                    \n                  </ul>\n                \n              \n                \n                  <p>KidsMap provides the technical capability to find, view, compare, and save information, as well as to contact the respective organizations.</p>\n                \n              \n                \n                  <p>Unless expressly stated otherwise, KidsMap:</p>\n                \n              \n                \n                  <ul class="legal-bullets-list">\n                    \n                      <li>is not the organizer of classes and events;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>does not provide services on behalf of the listed organizations;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>is not the employer of trainers or teachers;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>is not the agent or representative of the listing owners;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>is not a party to the contract between the user and the organization;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>does not make decisions on a child&#x27;s enrollment;</li>\n                    \n                      <li>is not responsible for the provision of classes by the organization to the extent permitted by law.</li>\n                    \n                  </ul>\n                \n              \n                \n                  <p>Agreements on classes, payment, refunds, attendance, security, and other conditions arise directly between the user and the chosen organization unless
